summary: End-to-end verification of the 4 next-gen Gaming features (admin catalog editor, price watches / Fırsat Uyarıları, affiliate earnings, Gaming monthly budget). Backend: 19/19 new pytest tests pass against the preview backend (auth gates on admin/watches/earnings/budget, admin catalog list ~162 rows shape, PUT override → current_price_try updates & has_override=true, PUT unknown offer → 404 'Teklif bulunamadı', DELETE clears override, JSON import applied/skipped/errors accounting, CSV import multipart with utf-8-sig, reset endpoint 204, override reflected in /gaming/products/{id}, every offer.url contains ref=/aff=/utm_source= per seller, estimated_commission_try == price_try * rate for all 7 sellers, purchase persists estimated_commission_try + commission_rate and populates GET /gaming/earnings & /gaming/earnings/all, watch create returns triggered flag, /api/alerts includes gaming-watch-<uuid> when triggered, PATCH updates target, DELETE removes, budget GET returns limit=null when unset then PUT/DELETE roundtrip works with spent/percent/exceeded). Previous iteration 2 tests still pass (not re-run in this iteration to save time, unchanged). Frontend: Playwright verified on preview URL — Dashboard shows gaming-earnings-card (demo has Gaming purchases). /gaming header shows Katalog düzenle link (gaming-admin-link), watches panel, budget CTA (limit unset), earnings chip. /gaming/admin renders all 7 controls (json-input, json-apply, csv-btn, export, reset, filter-game, filter-overrides) and 162 save buttons; editing a row + Save shows 'Fiyat güncellendi' toast and adds Düzenlendi clear button; JSON apply shows '1 teklif güncellendi · 0 atlandı' toast; Reset clears overrides. /gaming/products/{id} shows gaming-watch-add + 3 commission chips; Takibe al modal submits and button flips to gaming-watch-remove; remove works. /settings shows settings-gaming-budget panel with input/save/status/clear — save shows status, clear removes it. All navigations succeed.

issues: Console still emits repeated 'Failed to load resource: 400' errors on nearly every page (same noise flagged in iteration 2). Likely a debug/log-ping endpoint or an unauthenticated stat call; not blocking any Gaming flow but should be silenced.

Base UI console warning: 'A component is changing the default value state of an uncontrolled FieldControl after being initialized.' Cosmetic — the inputs still work but consider controlling them with useState for stability.

action_items: Investigate the recurring 400 responses in the browser console (pre-existing — carry-over from iteration 2).
Convert the uncontrolled inputs in GamingAdmin.tsx price/delivery/campaign fields to controlled state to silence the Base UI warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/gaming.py: `_CATALOG_CACHE` is global and mutated on first read. Since apply_overrides clones the dict per user, this is safe today, but any accidental mutation of the cached dict would leak across users. Consider freezing/deep-copying in `catalog()` for defense in depth.

routers/gaming.py `set_gaming_budget` and `_find_gaming_budget` treat `month` = '' as 'always-on' fallback; combined with month-specific docs this can create surprising precedence. Document or normalize to a single strategy.
gaming_catalog.py `build_catalog()` still contains the O(N*M) `_product_ids` computation flagged in iteration 2 — minor, mentioned again for continuity.
GamingBudgetSet has no upper bound; a huge float would still be accepted. Add a sensible max (e.g. 1e9).
seed_data_creation: One temporary Gaming purchase created during test_purchase_records_commission_and_earnings and immediately deleted. Budget & overrides written/cleared with fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_gaming_nextgen.py hard-codes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fallback to the preview URL because cookies set by /auth/login are Secure. Run with `-o addopts=` to bypass pytest.ini's xdist requirement (module fixture is not xdist-safe when running only one file). Tests are idempotent: fixture resets overrides + budget on setup and teardown.
